metadata.scope: Add one authenticated staging Playwright spec that opens real /admin/members, selects synthetic test members, applies a real POST /admin/members/tags/bulk mutation, and captures the result-summary all-success and partial-failure (deleted-member skipped) baselines. A dedicated seed/cleanup SQL pair (e2e_test_issue1125_ prefix, no explicit SQL transaction per D1 remote constraint) plus a trap-cleanup shell runner orchestrate seed -> capture -> cleanup with residual-zero verification. The notFound (unregistered tag) visual is out of scope because the tag picker only renders registered tags; it stays covered by the parent local fixture + BulkActionBar.spec.tsx TC-BAB-TAG-03.
metadata.runtime_boundary: This wave adds the Playwright spec, seed/cleanup SQL, capture runner, and local shell test. Authenticated staging seed -> mutation -> baseline generation -> cleanup, staging deploy, commit, push, and PR remain user-gated. GitHub issue #1125 stays CLOSED (recovered_from_unassigned / refs_only).
metadata.optimization_note: Issue #1125 was written (2026-06-03) for a manual user-gated screenshot capture of the result 2 states. Since then the authenticated staging Playwright infrastructure (setup.staging-auth.ts, staging-visual-authenticated project) and the issue-1081 staging D1 seed/cleanup+redact runner (scripts/smoke/runtime-tag-bulk.sh) landed. This spec optimizes the root solution to a mutation interaction-gated authenticated staging Playwright spec plus a trap-cleanup seed/cleanup runner, instead of a manual capture.
metadata.scope_decision: Investigation confirmed the result 2 states (all-success / partial-failure) staging mutation visual baseline is unresolved: issue-1036 only has page.setContent() local fixtures, issue-1077 scoped result states out (read-only picker only), issue-1081/#1144 is NON_VISUAL (API smoke), issue-1080 is local component test. partial-failure is reproduced via a seeded deleted member (member_status.is_deleted=1) -> skipped_deleted -> frontend skipped list. notFound (unregistered tag) cannot be produced through the UI and remains covered by parent local fixtures + BulkActionBar.spec.tsx TC-BAB-TAG-03.
